Intel: Python code with medium chunk size

```rust title="Rust"
use tree_sitter_language_pack::process;

fn main() {
    let source = r#"def first():
    x = 1
    return x

def second():
    y = 2
    return y

def third():
    z = 3
    return z
"#;
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"chunk_max_size":50,"language":"python"}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let _ = process(source, &config);
    println!("{:?}", result.language);
    println!("{:?}", result.structure);
    println!("{:?}", result.metrics.error_count);
    println!("{:?}", result.chunks);
}
```
